raw_title: The Politics of the “Non-Political”: A Conceptual Review
title_en: The Politics of the “Non-Political”: A Conceptual Review
title_zh: The Politics of the “Non-Political”: A Conceptual Review
plain_summary_en: This paper studies The Politics of the “Non-Political”: A Conceptual Review. In plain terms, it asks what is happening, why it matters for public communication, and what evidence the authors use. The likely focus is Politics, Sociology, Epistemology, Political science. The abstract suggests a review approach, which makes the work useful for understanding how communication changes in everyday life.
